description: This file contains a SCSS mixin named 'generate-utility' used for generating CSS utility classes and variables, primarily for printing and utility CSS styles. It includes logic for handling different property value types, responsive fluid values, CSS variables, RTL support, and pseudo-classes.

methods.name: generate-utility
methods.description: A SCSS mixin that generates utility CSS classes with customizable properties, states, responsive values, and support for CSS variables and RTL.
